index.name: The Holding Intelligence Index
index.disclaimer: A deterministic maturity index for The Holding Brain. It is not psychometric IQ and it does not measure human intelligence.

evaluation.historicalQuestionChecksNote: Exact cumulative question executions were not durably counted before Intelligence Progress v0.1. The UI therefore reports verified Ask runs and the current static question bank without inventing a historical question total.

bottleneck.label: Experience
bottleneck.summary: The system has more observation and evaluation evidence than settled real-world outcomes. More decision → outcome → lesson cycles are the highest-value next intelligence gain.

authority.note: THI is read-only progress telemetry. It cannot execute capital actions, change methodology, or self-promote capabilities.
